description: This file defines constants, interfaces, and functions for managing Microsoft Foundry provider configurations, including model handling, endpoint normalization, credential building, and profile management within a larger AI/ML project.

classes.name: AzAccount
classes.description: Represents an Azure account with optional tenant and user info.

classes.name: AzAccessToken
classes.description: Represents an Azure access token with expiration info.

classes.name: AzCognitiveAccount
classes.description: Represents an Azure Cognitive Services account.

classes.name: FoundryResourceOption
classes.description: Options for Foundry resources including endpoint and project info.

classes.name: FoundrySelection
classes.description: Selection info for Foundry models including endpoint and API.

classes.name: FoundryProviderApi
classes.description: Type representing supported Foundry provider APIs.

classes.name: FoundryConfigShape
classes.description: Shape of the overall Foundry configuration object.

methods.name: normalizeFoundryModelName
methods.description: Normalizes model name string to lowercase trimmed value or undefined.

methods.name: usesFoundryResponsesByDefault
methods.description: Determines if a model name indicates usage of Foundry responses by default.

methods.name: requiresFoundryMaxCompletionTokens
methods.description: Checks if a model name requires max completion tokens.

methods.name: isFoundryProviderApi
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a valid Foundry provider API.

methods.name: normalizeFoundryEndpoint
methods.description: Normalizes a URL endpoint string for Foundry.

methods.name: buildFoundryV1BaseUrl
methods.description: Builds the base URL for Foundry v1 API.

methods.name: resolveFoundryApi
methods.description: Resolves the API type based on model ID, hint, and configuration.

methods.name: buildFoundryProviderBaseUrl
methods.description: Builds the provider base URL for Foundry models.

methods.name: extractFoundryEndpoint
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the Foundry endpoint from a URL string.

methods.name: buildFoundryModelCompat
methods.description: Builds compatibility info for a Foundry model based on API and name.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredModelNameHint
methods.description: Resolves the model name hint or ID to a trimmed string.

methods.name: buildFoundryProviderConfig
methods.description: Constructs provider configuration object for Foundry, including models and API details.

methods.name: buildFoundryCredentialMetadata
methods.description: Builds credential metadata record for Foundry authentication.

methods.name: buildPluginsAllowPatch
methods.description: Creates a patch to allowlist the provider in plugin configurations.

methods.name: buildFoundryAuthOrderPatch
methods.description: Creates a patch to update the authentication order with a new profile ID.

methods.name: listConfiguredFoundryProfileIds
methods.description: Lists profile IDs configured for the Foundry provider.

methods.name: buildFoundryAuthResult
methods.description: Builds the authentication result object including profiles and config patch.

methods.name: applyFoundryProfileBinding
methods.description: Applies a profile binding to the Foundry configuration.

methods.name: applyFoundryProviderConfig
methods.description: Adds or updates the provider configuration in the overall config.

methods.name: resolveFoundryTargetProfileId
methods.description: Resolves the target profile ID based on config profile order and provider.
